mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.subtitle: Connect, organize, and securely read all of your IMAP and POP3 inboxes.
mailboxes.outlook_browser_opened: Complete Outlook sign-in in your browser. ViralCloner will continue automatically.
mailboxes.outlook_timeout: Outlook sign-in timed out. Please try again.
mailboxes.outlook_failed: Outlook sign-in was not completed. Please try again.
mailboxes.gmail_help_intro: Use an app password and enable IMAP before testing the mailbox connection.
mailboxes.gmail_help_step1_a: Go to your Google Account Security Settings.
mailboxes.gmail_help_step1_b: In "How you sign in to Google", open 2-Step Verification and turn it on.
mailboxes.gmail_help_step2_b: Enter an app name (for example: ViralCloner).
mailboxes.gmail_help_step2_c: Click Create and copy the 16-character app password.
mailboxes.gmail_help_step2_d: Use that 16-character app password in the Password field here.
mailboxes.gmail_help_imap_title: Step 3: Enable IMAP and use these server settings
mailboxes.gmail_help_imap_a: In Gmail, open Settings -> See all settings -> Forwarding and POP/IMAP.
mailboxes.gmail_help_imap_c: Use IMAP server: imap.gmail.com, Port: 993, Security: TLS/SSL.
mailboxes.gmail_help_imap_d: Username: your full Gmail address. Password: your app password (not your normal Gmail password).
mailboxes.imap_help_title: Turn on IMAP for this mailbox
mailboxes.imap_help_intro: Outlook accepted the sign-in but IMAP is switched off for this account. Enable it in the account's own Outlook.com settings:
mailboxes.imap_help_step1: Open Outlook.com and sign in with the same account.
mailboxes.imap_help_step2: Go to Settings (gear icon) → Mail → Sync email.
mailboxes.imap_help_step3: Under POP and IMAP, turn on "Let devices and apps use IMAP".
mailboxes.imap_help_step4: Save, then come back here and choose Try again. (It can take a few minutes to apply.)
mailboxes.empty_text: Add your first mailbox to securely read and organize email here.
